Ui.Script:
if LootFrame and GetLootSections then -- The area window's geometry, in LootFrame units. Rows keep the stock left edge and -- first-row top (LootFrame.xml: LootButton1 at 24, -80); the stock window is 256 tall. local LEFT = 24 local TOP = 80 local BOTTOM = 52 -- the pager's strip (LootFrame.xml: the arrows at 16) local SCALE = 0.85 -- a compact row: the 37 px item button at 31 local ROW_PITCH = 33 local HEADER_HEIGHT = 15 local DIVIDER_WIDTH = 150 local STOCK_HEIGHT = 256 -- The panel art (LootFrame.xml:88) in three pieces, so a taller window stretches only -- its plain middle: the top 96 and the bottom 32 texture rows keep their size. local ART = "Interface\\LootFrame\\UI-LootPanel" local ART_TOP = 96 local ART_BOTTOM = 32
local stockUpdate = LootFrame_Update local stockOnShow = LootFrame_OnShow local stockOnEvent = LootFrame_OnEvent
local buttons = {} local headers = {} local art, artMiddle, artBottom, others
-- The stock panel texture: unnamed, so found among the window's regions. local function PanelArt() if art then return art end local regions = { LootFrame:GetRegions() } for i = 1, table.getn(regions) do local r = regions[i] if r:GetObjectType() == "Texture" then local file = r:GetTexture() if file and string.find(string.lower(file), "ui%-lootpanel") then art = r end end end return art end
-- Taller for an area window, or back to the stock shape with no height. local function Shape(height) local panel = PanelArt() if not artMiddle then artMiddle = LootFrame:CreateTexture("BenillaLootFrameArtMiddle", "BACKGROUND") artMiddle:SetTexture(ART) artBottom = LootFrame:CreateTexture("BenillaLootFrameArtBottom", "BACKGROUND") artBottom:SetTexture(ART) others = LootFrame:CreateFontString("BenillaLootFrameOthers", "OVERLAY", "NumberFontNormal") others:SetPoint("BOTTOMRIGHT", LootFramePortraitOverlay, "BOTTOMRIGHT", -4, 4) end if not height then LootFrame:SetHeight(STOCK_HEIGHT) if panel then panel:ClearAllPoints() panel:SetAllPoints(LootFrame) panel:SetTexCoord(0, 1, 0, 1) end artMiddle:Hide() artBottom:Hide() others:Hide() return end LootFrame:SetHeight(height) if panel then panel:ClearAllPoints() panel:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", LootFrame, "TOPLEFT", 0, 0) panel:SetWidth(256) panel:SetHeight(ART_TOP) panel:SetTexCoord(0, 1, 0, ART_TOP / 256) end artMiddle:ClearAllPoints() artMiddle:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", LootFrame, "TOPLEFT", 0, -ART_TOP) artMiddle:SetWidth(256) artMiddle:SetHeight(height - ART_TOP - ART_BOTTOM) artMiddle:SetTexCoord(0, 1, ART_TOP / 256, (256 - ART_BOTTOM) / 256) artMiddle:Show() artBottom:ClearAllPoints() artBottom:SetPoint("BOTTOMLEFT", LootFrame, "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, 0) artBottom:SetWidth(256) artBottom:SetHeight(ART_BOTTOM) artBottom:SetTexCoord(0, 1, (256 - ART_BOTTOM) / 256, 1) artBottom:Show() end
-- The stock row hover (LootFrame.xml:39-46) with the row's own slot, as a page here -- holds rows the stock pager's arithmetic does not know. local function RowOnEnter() if LootSlotIsItem(this.slot) then GameTooltip:SetOwner(this, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetLootItem(this.slot) CursorUpdate() end end
local function Row(i) if not buttons[i] then local b = CreateFrame("LootButton", "BenillaLootButton"..i, LootFrame, "LootButtonTemplate") b:SetScale(SCALE) b:SetScript("OnEnter", RowOnEnter) buttons[i] = b end return buttons[i] end
local function Header(i) if not headers[i] then local h = {} h.text = LootFrame:CreateFontString("BenillaLootHeader"..i, "OVERLAY", "GameFontNormalSmall") h.text:SetJustifyH("LEFT") h.text:SetWidth(DIVIDER_WIDTH) h.line = LootFrame:CreateTexture("BenillaLootHeader"..i.."Line", "OVERLAY") h.line:SetTexture(1.0, 0.82, 0.0, 0.6) h.line:SetWidth(DIVIDER_WIDTH) h.line:SetHeight(1) headers[i] = h end return headers[i] end
local function Height(lines) local h = 0 for i = 1, table.getn(lines) do if type(lines[i]) == "string" then h = h + HEADER_HEIGHT else h = h + ROW_PITCH end end return h end
local function PageHasLoot(page) local lines = LootFrame.benillaPages[page] if not lines then return nil end for i = 1, table.getn(lines) do local slot = lines[i] if type(slot) == "number" and (LootSlotIsItem(slot) or LootSlotIsCoin(slot)) then return 1 end end return nil end
-- `LootFrame_Update` for an area window: the page's headers and rows top to bottom; a -- taken row is a gap in place, as the stock window leaves one. local function AreaUpdate() local pages = LootFrame.benillaPages local lines = pages[LootFrame.page] or {} local y = -TOP local rows, heads = 0, 0 for i = 1, table.getn(lines) do local line = lines[i] if type(line) == "string" then heads = heads + 1 local h = Header(heads) h.text:ClearAllPoints() h.text:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", LootFrame, "TOPLEFT", LEFT, y) h.text:SetText(line) h.text:Show() h.line:ClearAllPoints() h.line:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", LootFrame, "TOPLEFT", LEFT, y - 11) h.line:Show() y = y - HEADER_HEIGHT else rows = rows + 1 local b = Row(rows) local name = b:GetName() -- An anchor offset is in the button's own (scaled) units. b:ClearAllPoints() b:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", LootFrame, "TOPLEFT", LEFT / SCALE, y / SCALE) b.slot = line if LootSlotIsItem(line) or LootSlotIsCoin(line) then local texture, item, quantity, quality = GetLootSlotInfo(line) local color = ITEM_QUALITY_COLORS[quality] getglobal(name.."IconTexture"):SetTexture(texture) getglobal(name.."Text"):SetText(item) getglobal(name.."Text"):SetVertexColor(color.r, color.g, color.b) local count = getglobal(name.."Count") if quantity > 1 then count:SetText(quantity) count:Show() else count:Hide() end b:SetSlot(line) b.quality = quality b:Show() else b:Hide() end y = y - ROW_PITCH end end for i = rows + 1, table.getn(buttons) do buttons[i]:Hide() end for i = heads + 1, table.getn(headers) do headers[i].text:Hide() headers[i].line:Hide() end local n = GetLootSections() if n and n > 0 then others:SetText("+"..n) others:Show() else others:Hide() end if LootFrame.page > 1 then LootFrameUpButton:Show() LootFramePrev:Show() else LootFrameUpButton:Hide() LootFramePrev:Hide() end if LootFrame.page < table.getn(pages) then LootFrameDownButton:Show() LootFrameNext:Show() else LootFrameDownButton:Hide() LootFrameNext:Hide() end end
-- Leaves the area shape for the stock one. local function Unshape() LootFrame.benillaPages = nil Shape(nil) for i = 1, table.getn(buttons) do buttons[i]:Hide() end for i = 1, table.getn(headers) do headers[i].text:Hide() headers[i].line:Hide() end end
function LootFrame_Update() if LootFrame.benillaPages then AreaUpdate() else stockUpdate() end end
function LootFrame_OnShow() local _, pages = GetLootSections() if pages then LootFrame.benillaPages = pages local tallest = 0 for p = 1, table.getn(pages) do local h = Height(pages[p]) if h > tallest then tallest = h end end local height = TOP + tallest + BOTTOM if height < STOCK_HEIGHT then height = STOCK_HEIGHT end Shape(height) for i = 1, LOOTFRAME_NUMBUTTONS do getglobal("LootButton"..i):Hide() end elseif LootFrame.benillaPages then Unshape() end stockOnShow() end
function LootFrame_OnEvent(event) if event == "LOOT_SLOT_CLEARED" and LootFrame.benillaPages then if not this:IsVisible() then return end AreaUpdate() -- An emptied page turns to the nearest page with loot left. if not PageHasLoot(LootFrame.page) then local count = table.getn(LootFrame.benillaPages) for d = 1, count do if PageHasLoot(LootFrame.page + d) then LootFrame.page = LootFrame.page + d AreaUpdate() return elseif PageHasLoot(LootFrame.page - d) then LootFrame.page = LootFrame.page - d AreaUpdate() return end end end return end stockOnEvent(event) end end
